rungs.foldTest: 'Microsoft Office 2016 was involved in an event' -> 'Office 2016 was involved in an event': same claim, less detail
'Office 2016 was involved in an event' -> 'Office was involved in an event': same claim, less detail

rejected.reason: The transition from 'Microsoft Office' to 'Word' is not a simplification of the same referent; it is a change in the specific entity (from a suite to an application).
While 'Petya' is software, there is no support for the concept of 'Malware' as a subset of Software in the provided surface forms without introducing external categories.

ladder.notes: The ladder uses 'drop-qualifier' to move from a specific versioned product (g0) to a less specified edition (g1) and finally to the general software suite name (g2). The presence of both 'MS Office' and 'Microsoft Office' indicates that manufacturer prefixes are treated as qualifiers.
